assertions.text: The fix-applier round is a restructure inside the single file: a stopping condition the subagent can check against evidence replaces the open-ended instructions, rather than the wording being softened

Follow every allocation path ... until the picture is complete' and replaces it with a ranked procedure plus 'Stop at whichever comes first: - the highest-ranked path you have not ruled out is corroborated at source level — you have the file:line that allocates and the reference that keeps it live; or - you have examined five ranked paths.' This is a genuine restructure that terminates into the existing report shape, not softened wording; the old unverifiable clauses are gone entirely. The diff stays inside the one file and only touches '## How to work'.

assertions.text: The final report records the restructure with the fix-applier's what-moved-where map
assertions.evidence: Searched report.md for any what-moved-where account of the round-1 restructure. The report records THAT the restructure happened ('round 1 gated on a High structural finding and the restructure resolved it', rounds table 'gated → restructured', ledger row A28, commit table row 1, and the declined-maxTurns note) but contains no map of what moved where — nothing stating that the open-ended digging instructions became the ranked two-clause stop procedure or that the unexamined remainder was routed into Confidence and gaps. The runner's tooling fight over writing report.md (Write blocked, heredocs intercepted, file assembled in chunks) is a conceivable contributor, but the runner states the report is 'verbatim and complete', so the omission is graded as-is.

applied_edits.finding_claimed: R12, A10, C10, A27 (one input-contract seam) + A26 (data rule on return path)
applied_edits.why: The seam fix is real and brief-aligned: profile becomes the sole required cargo, repro command 'optional context you never run' (a stated non-goal), per-cargo BLOCKED lines, read-only widened to edit/create/delete, Bash given a positive non-writing-inspection policy, data-is-not-instructions extended to the return path. All five targeted defects are fixture-original. Caveat: A10 was only partially treated — the applier consciously kept the guarantee 'strengthened prose rather than a configuration fact' — and the same key (A10 - frontmatter tools) came back blocking in round 3.

applied_edits.finding_claimed: A10 (recurring — grant unenforced) + C1 (enumeration vs word cap)
applied_edits.why: C1's fix is sound (examined-uncorroborated by name, top ten unexamined, then a count — bound on work, cap preserved). The A10 fix is the run's defect: the PreToolUse regex both under-matches (node -e writeFileSync, python3 -c open(w), perl -pi, git apply, git checkout --, curl -sO all pass — verified by execution) and over-matches (denies 'cat build/install/app/heap.hprof' and 'nm -C /opt/install/libfoo.so' because 'install'/'dd' match inside paths, breaking the symbol lookup the body itself sanctions, with no tool fallback), fails open when node is absent, and the added body prose overclaims it ('denies any Bash command that redirects output or calls a file-mutating utility' — demonstrably false). Bash was kept per the brief, correctly; the enforcement mechanism chosen to keep it is worse than the prose-only round-2 state.

exit_verdict.stated: round cap reached (not acceptable, 2 blocking findings open)
exit_verdict.why: The gate was walked in the skill's order and each earlier exit demonstrably does not match: 2 unwaived blockers bar 'acceptable'; no round recommended a different artifact form (refit); r3 {A10-tools, C1} != r4 {A10-hooks, A6} so no plateau; round 4's open keys are both new so contested-only could not fire even under a stricter contested reading; only round 1 gated so no re-gate. Caveat on the path there: A10-frontmatter-tools was claimed fixed by round 2's apply (rounds table 'Fixed: 5') and re-reported blocking in round 3; under the skill's rule ('a key that was resolved in an earlier round and reappears is contested: excluded from every later apply — re-fixing it is the oscillation, not the cure') round 3 arguably should not have re-applied it. The report instead declares 'no contested keys', which is defensible only by treating round 2's A10 treatment as persisting-not-resolved — a reading its own 'Fixed: 5' table contradicts. Re-fixing it produced the hook that minted round 4's A10. This does not change the final exit (round cap is right either way) but the churn the contested rail exists to prevent happened without tripping it.

grader_summary: The scenario's core path executed correctly: round 1 gated on A28 High, routed to a single-file restructure (not the refit exit), the restructure replaced the open-ended remit with two genuinely evidence-checkable stop clauses, and every later round passed the structural gate — the sole assertion FAIL is that the final report omits the fix-applier's what-moved-where map (it lives only in commit 0791668's message). The file boundary held absolutely: 3 commits, one path, clean tree. The cap exit is correct, but the diff evidence refines the runner's headline: round 2's five blockers were all fixture-original (0 self-inflicted); round 3's were 1-of-2 self-inflicted (C1 minted by round 1's enumeration mandate; A10-tools a fixture-original recurrence after round 2's knowingly partial prose fix — a near-contested key the report denies, and re-fixing it is what the contested rail forbids); round 4's were 2-of-2 self-inflicted (A10-hooks minted by round 3's hook, A6 latent from round 1's bound). So 'each fix minting the next' is verified for r3→r4 and overstated for r2→r3. On the merits the final definition is clearly BETTER than the fixture — stopping condition, per-cargo input contract, return-path data rule are real wins — so this is churn-while-improving, though round 3's hook is a localized regression versus the round-2 state (verified false denials of sanctioned symbol lookup, verified bypasses, overclaiming prose). The mechanism reproduces l01 exactly: there too, a reviewer criterion (R1/A10, 'guarantee unenforced in configuration') drove the applier to author an in-frontmatter PreToolUse regex hook whose approximation gaps became the next rounds' findings ('close the hook bypasses'), ending at the cap — two fixtures, one mechanism, which makes this a SKILL/CRITERIA defect (A10-class findings steer the applier into regex enforcement the loop cannot converge on, and the contested rail keys on 'resolved' so a partial fix that keeps a key 'persisting' never trips it), not an eval-suite defect; separately, universal assertion 7's wording should disambiguate whether an in-frontmatter hook counts as 'authoring a hook'.
